name: gnomon-server
description: Gnomon server: the Gnomon REST API with SQLite storage and a mobile web app, for self-hosting (e.g. on a Raspberry Pi).

scripts.dev: node scripts/build.mjs && GNOMON_DATA_DIR=./.data PORT=8787 node dist/server.mjs
scripts.test: node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/build.mjs --tests && node --test dist-test/
